limitations: Daily pool contains trends whose visible start was 11 October in Europe/Madrid; their volumes come from the captured rolling 48-hour table, not a natural-day total.
Weekly pool is rolling seven days captured on 12 October, not seven completed calendar days.
English clock-change volume is unknown. Spanish cambio horario octubre is the observed topic signal; English educational SERP intent was checked separately.
No sightings, deaths, allegations or causes of a query spike are inferred from Trends.
Thirty-day saved research and content/research checked: existing Academy keywords are already covered and do not supply the new topics. No paid research used.

cambio horario octubre 2026 España BOE ultimo domingo
serp.intent: Educational reason plus practical date/time. English results include Royal Observatory Greenwich, Queen’s University Belfast, government material and clock-change explanations. Spanish results combine date questions with speculation; use BOE only for confirmed date.

sources.claims: Energetic electrons follow magnetic field lines, collisions excite gases, emitted light; changing oval/curtains and darkness needed.
Oxygen green/red; nitrogen blue/purple; northern/southern names.
Particles, atmosphere and Sun/Earth magnetic interaction; aurora names.
UK 25 October 2026 at 02:00 ->01:00; last Sundays; BST to GMT.
Summer-time redistribution morning to evening and return in autumn; not a promise of energy benefit.
Spain Sunday25October2026 at03:00->02:00; Canary Islands02:00->01:00; calendar date does not abolish rules.
Return from BST to GMT; weekend disruption and different regional rules.
